title: Visitor car parking: 0.1 bays per dwelling (Location A) or 0.15 (Location B) (Table 2.3a)
text: Visitor car parking is provided on site in accordance with Table 2.3a. Table 2.3a Car parking¹, Visitor: Location A 0.1 bays per dwelling; Location B 0.15 bays per dwelling. ¹Calculations of parking ratios shall be rounded to the nearest whole number, with fractions of 0.5 or greater rounded up (for example, 1.4 bays is rounded to 1 bay and 1.5 bays is rounded to 2 bays).

evaluator.label: 0.1 (Location A) or 0.15 (Location B) bays per dwelling, rounded to the nearest whole number with 0.5 rounded up

replaces.note: 0-4 nil; 5-8 1; 9-12 2; 13+ 3 plus 1 per four -> 0.1 / 0.15 per dwelling

notes: from: ch3 C2.3.3. diverges: no 0-4 dwelling exemption (Table 2.3a p20 has none, register C4P1-040), so the five-dwelling condition is dropped: 4 apartments in Location B need 1 bay (0.6 rounds up). Region all. Worked: 12 apartments A 1 / B 2; 20 apartments A 2 / B 3. '+ 0.001' makes Python round() round 0.5 up. Chapter 1 Table 2.5A lets an LPP reduce visitor bays without WAPC approval. The required bay count comes from table-2.3a-visitor-bays, keyed on site.location (rows A and B only): an unknown location gives CANNOT_TELL, where the earlier 'A else B' formula treated any value other than 'A' as Location B.
